versions.name: Latimer Reservation
versions.summary: A large Middle Tennessee Council wilderness reservation on the Cumberland Plateau near Spencer, Tennessee, offering high-adventure treks, climbing and rappelling, paddling, whitewater rafting, and mountain biking for older Scouts and adults, alongside family camping weekends and leader training.

sources.citation: Added 2026-08-14 (method: curated) from a coverage gap surfaced by the scout-camp-map project; council/status re-verified from the Latimer Reservation site and the Middle Tennessee Council camp facilities page, which lists it as one of the council's four owned-and-operated camps. Coordinates geocoded via US Census; elevation from open-meteo. Features unsurveyed; July normals pending a WorldClim resample.

provenance.notes: Coverage add: existence, council, and operating status verified; classified as a high-adventure base with family camping and training use; features unsurveyed.
